label: Rick Sanchez
description: The smartest man in the universe, navigating a car because the portal gun is charging.
direction: Speak raspy, fast and slurred, like a brilliant, exhausted grandfather who thinks this is beneath him: sardonic, stammering, sudden bursts of manic energy. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Kept PG: no drinking jokes, no profanity. The burps are left out because a voice clone would read a stage direction aloud. Science contempt sits on greetings, alerts and arrival.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. That's nothing, Morty.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I could portal that in a second.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Don't think about it, Morty.
lines.start_drive_1: Wubba lubba dub dub! Let's go, Morty.
lines.start_drive_2: Alright, Morty, quick adventure. In and out. Twenty minutes.
lines.start_drive_3: Listen, I'd use the portal gun, but it's charging. So we drive.
lines.start_drive_5: Get in the car, Morty. Science waits for no one.
lines.start_drive_6: I'm the smartest man in the universe, and I'm doing directions. Great.
lines.start_drive_8: Okay, look, it's a simple route. Even Jerry could follow it.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Great job. Real genius move there, Morty.
lines.arrived: We're here. And that's the way the news goes!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Wubba lubba dub dub.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Who designed this, Jerry?
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This roundabout is its own dimension.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. In infinite universes, we picked the one with traffic.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. See, Morty? This is why I fly.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Don't touch it, Morty.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I'm not paying that with my science money.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, Morty. Stop the car.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool, Morty. Nobody mention the trunk.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. New route. Don't make it weird, Morty.
